about: Animation frames for DeepSeek-Pet. Each frame is one original picture with only the masked part redrawn. Regions are in sprite pixels (908x1337, see ART_CANVAS in art/states.mjs); masks.py maps them onto the originals. Paths are relative to this folder.

frames.name: idle-blink
frames.prompt:
Edit the attached image. This is one frame of an animation of the same character, so it must stay aligned with the original. Change ONLY both eyes. Everything else must stay exactly as it is: the same canvas size and 2:3 portrait aspect ratio, the same framing, the character at the same size and in the same position, and the same pose, face, hair, whale-fin ears, tail, outfit, colours, line art and shading. Do not redraw, restyle, crop, zoom, shift or re-pose anything. Keep the transparent background; if you cannot, use a plain white background, never a checkerboard pattern. No text, no other people, no hands holding her.

The change: Close both eyes, as at the instant of a blink: the upper eyelids come all the way down to meet the lower eyelids, so each eye becomes a single soft dark lash line that curves slightly downward, in the same colour and line style as her lashes. Keep the eyebrows, the skin tone and the blush under the eyes.
